en: A black-and-white photograph on a postcard shows a mid-20th-century cargo or tanker vessel sailing through a wide body of water. The ship's name 'FLIPPER' is visible on the bow. In the distant background, a distinctive clock tower or harbor building can be faintly seen, giving the impression of a port or harbor setting, possibly European due to the architecture and ship style.
